verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships a dedicated Insights feature (CLI and dashboard) exposing aggregated query statistics, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema/index recommendations computed from production traffic, plus a 'list top queries by performance metric' capability — directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates real-world use: a user reports the Insights tab surfaced missing indexes that improved performance after migrating to PlanetScale. Missing for 10: no dedicated screenshot/deep-dive of a full built-in dashboard UI beyond CLI/docs description.
